correctness.rationale: For the absolutely continuous stationary law use X=2^(−J)U with geometric J of ratio r=q/p and independent uniform U. The reflected walk leaves this law stationary, and a doubling at depth zero is exactly one shift of U. Fair binary digits give E[U{2^k U}]=1/4+2^(−k)/12. This splits C_n into the centered depth term for P_1 and the uncentered term for P_{1/2}, with zero-loop weight b. To check the required spectral bound, conjugate by sqrt(π) to a symmetric half-line tridiagonal with off-diagonal c=sqrt(pq) and boundary diagonal a=pb. Outside [−2c,2c] an ℓ² eigenmode must decay geometrically with factor c/a, so it exists only when a>c and then has eigenvalue a+c²/a. For b=1 it is the simple constant mode at 1 before conjugation; for b=1/2 it exists only for p>4/5 and is strictly below 1. This gives absolute summability and the resolvent identity on the required subspaces. Substitution at both j=0 and j≥1 verifies the two Poisson solutions in RESULT.md; the first is in L²(π) and the second bounded. Contracting with the indicated weights gives S=(51p³−51p²+17p−1)/[3(3p−1)³(5p−1)], C_0=s/3−m²/4 and σ²=2S−C_0 by the stationary variance sum and absolute summability. At p→1/2 the rational σ² tends to 4, geometric J escapes, and C_0=(16/9)(p−1/2)+O((p−1/2)²). At p=1 the uniform doubling covariance is 2^(−n)/12, giving 1/4. There is no critical-state CLT or variance assertion. RESULT.md lines 25–78 are the all-time analytic replay; verify.py and VERIFICATION.md were inspected, not executed, and their finite tests do not prove the infinite result.

value.rationale: The coordinate is a standard observable of this map. The exact variance separates equilibrium collapse from a surviving time-integrated fluctuation, fixes the critical constant 4 and quantifies the divergence relative to C_0. Neither stationary moments alone nor short-lag correlations resolve that distinction, and the resolvent gives a useful exact benchmark for fluctuation and crossover analyses.
